overview: East Gwillimbury grew 44.4 per cent between 2016 and 2021 to reach 34,637 residents, making it Canada's fastest-growing municipality of its size. Its 11,449 occupied homes are spread across 245 square kilometres, in separate communities such as Holland Landing, Sharon, Queensville and Mount Albert.

Many households are new to the area and still choosing their providers. Local firms compete with Newmarket and Aurora next door, and new employment such as the Loblaw distribution centre will keep bringing in workers.
